project_info.theme: YSL lipstick as a symbol of class
project_info.color_palette: Black, gold, warm nude skin tone

main_subject.detail: A luxury editorial close-up of a hand with black nail polish slipping a black-and-gold YSL lipstick into a textured black blazer pocket. The bottom text says 'BIỂU TƯỢNG ĐẲNG CẤP'.
main_subject.style: Minimal high-fashion editorial product moment, tactile tailoring and luxury accessory styling

items: Top Left: Hand and fingers with black manicure entering from the upper edge
Top Right: Black textured blazer fabric filling the frame
Bottom Left: Soft fold shadows in the black garment
Bottom Right: Large white caption 'BIỂU TƯỢNG ĐẲNG CẤP'
Center/Background: Close-up of a YSL lipstick partially inserted into a blazer pocket, emphasizing the gold cassandre logo

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft fabric sheen, metallic gold pop on the logo, elegant skin-to-textile contrast

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square luxury editorial poster for YSL lipstick. Centerpiece is a photoreal close-up of a hand with black nail polish slipping a black-and-gold YSL lipstick into the pocket of a textured black blazer. Include the exact text 'BIỂU TƯỢNG ĐẲNG CẤP'. Technical style: photoreal luxury editorial product composite, editorial fashion close-up lighting, elegant fabric texture and metallic logo contrast, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: YSL lipstick with gold cassandre logo
assets.usage: Match the closed lipstick casing and visible gold logo placement

assets.name: Hand with black manicure
assets.usage: Preserve the grip and the elegant black-polished nails

assets.name: Black tailored blazer fabric

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: This is an editorial luxury detail shot. Keep it intimate and tactile. The lipstick should feel like an accessory tucked into tailoring, not a standalone packshot.
